title: Daily Workout · November 14
note: Saturday · approximately 47 minutes: six established opening stretches (6 min), incline treadmill walking (35 min), and gentle neutral-spine core work (6 min). Recovery-oriented day after Friday upper-body strength and posture; posture mini-routine rests today (target 3–4 days weekly, not daily). Treadmill inclines remain fixed 3% steady and alternating 2%/4% every 3 min; walking only up to 4.2 mph, no jogging. Use older HOKA Clifton 9 Wide (2E) only temporarily; replace high-mileage shoes soon. Avoid New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v15 specifically due to tingling, not all New Balance models. Stop for tingling, numbness, sharp lumbar or knee pain. Six opening stretches and timers unchanged; plow pose with feet suspended is listed as preference but SKIP unless medically cleared due to neck/spine loading; existing floor-contact photograph is reference-only. No actual completed performance or dumbbell loads assumed. On future posture days use separate PT rubber band for pull-aparts and wall-mounted bands for chest stretch; no doorway stretch.

items.name: Single lean-back quad stretch
items.detail: 1 min · gently alternate sides within the minute
items.instructions: Seated on floor, one leg straight, other foot beside buttock; lean back with arm support only if comfortable. Skip if it provokes lumbar or knee pain. Use existing StretchCoach image registry entry.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Soles together, sit upright, do not force knees down. One 60-second hold, not separate left/right holds.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Use comfortable, controlled motion. Do not force rotation or continue if it provokes sharp back pain.

items.name: Plow pose with feet suspended
items.detail: 1 min timer · only if specifically cleared
items.instructions: Straight legs with feet suspended, not touching floor. Advanced neck/spine-loading inversion; do not perform without clearance for current lumbar symptoms. Existing photograph showing floor contact is reference-only.

items.name: Arm circles
items.instructions: Gentle circles, comfortable range; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Overhead triceps stretch
items.instructions: Gentle overhead stretch without forcing the shoulder or arching the back; timing is provisional pending confirmation of original prescribed duration.

items.name: Warm-up walk
items.instructions: Use HOKA Clifton 9 Wide (2E), not the New Balance 1080 v15. Begin comfortably and stop if symptoms recur.

items.name: Steady brisk walk
items.instructions: Maintain a constant 3% incline for this entire steady segment; walk with a natural stride and reduce speed if needed.

items.name: Incline walking intervals
items.detail: 15 min · 3.6–4.2 mph · alternate 2% and 4% incline every 3 min
items.instructions: Three-minute blocks at 2%, 4%, 2%, 4%, 2%. Brisk walking only, not jogging. Stop if tingling or back pain returns.

items.name: Cool-down walk
items.instructions: Gradually ease down to a comfortable pace.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Lie on back, knees bent above hips, arms toward ceiling. Slowly extend opposite arm and leg only as far as you can keep pelvis and lumbar spine comfortable and steady. Exhale gently, no straining. Shorten range or skip if back pain.

items.name: Bird dogs
items.instructions: On hands and knees, brace gently and extend opposite arm and leg only to body level, keeping hips square and lumbar spine neutral. Pause briefly and return slowly. Use arm-only or leg-only movements if needed; skip if painful.
